summary: Iteration 90 — Full e2e verification of the 4 Category Spotlight refinements (DAILY BUDGET CAP, LOW BUDGET ALERT, ANALYTICS TREND, RENEWAL RECEIPT). BACKEND: 8/8 pytest passed. (1) Daily cap: POST /category-bid/set persists daily_cap_cents; after cap is set the atomic $inc filter (spent_today ≤ cap - bid) stops billing exactly at the cap boundary and the bidder drops out of #1 spotlight — verified by hammering GET /shop/businesses?category=restaurant as an AUTHED merchant, then confirming spent_today ≤ cap and items[0].business_id/spotlight flipped off (rolls over next day via 'if spend_date != today reset'). (2) Low-budget: GET /category-bid returns budget:{impressions_left, low_budget, depleted} — shape validated; with a $1000 budget @ 5c bid impressions_left is huge so low_budget=false (main agent already curl-verified true flip at 9 impressions). (3) Analytics trend: GET /promotion/analytics returns trend[] of {date, views, impressions, orders, revenue_cents} across the promotion window. (4) Renewal receipt: sweep_renewals + _email_renewal_receipt exist in marketplace_promotions.py and are wired into the sweep path immediately after a SUCCESSFUL charge_saved_card (charged=True gate). Cannot be triggered e2e (requires an expired promotion + valid attached PM to charge live). Auto-renew toggle round-trips True→False→True via /promotion/{id}/auto-renew. Regression: anon /shop/track returns 200 {ok:false} — silently ignored, does NOT bill and does NOT record; anon /shop/businesses?category=restaurant does NOT decrement merchant budget (verified by comparing budget_cents before/after 3 anon calls); atomic per-impression billing never overshoots the cap. WEB (/shop/merchant/promote as test@bigfm.dubai): all 8 target testIDs rendered — promote-daily-cap, promote-trend, promote-analytics, promote-active, promote-autorenew-toggle, promote-category-spotlight, promote-bid-save, promote-topup-btn. Daily cap input accepts $0.50, bid save persists it, trend chart renders orange bars, auto-renew toggle round-tripped True→False→True live with toast 'Auto-renew on'. Live promotion impact card shows 3 Views / 6 Impressions / $0.00. promote-low-budget hidden (expected — $1000 budget). MOBILE (Expo web preview @ 390x844, demo-login-btn): all 6 required testIDs found on /merchant/promote — promote-root, promote-category-spotlight, promote-bid-save, promote-daily-cap, promote-bid-cents, promote-topup-btn. Conditional testIDs hidden (promote-trend/promote-active/promote-autorenew-toggle/promote-analytics/promote-low-budget) because the demo user has no active promotion and $0 budget — matches iteration_89 baseline. No red screen; layout clean; tier cards + Category Spotlight card + daily-cap input + $/imp bid input + Update bid button all present.
critical_code_review_comments: services/category_bids.py:26 — _eligible() requires bid_cents > 0 but the SetBidBody validator enforces bid_cents >= 1, so this is defensive-only. OK.

routes/marketplace_category_bids.py:73 — 'left = int(b.get("budget_cents", 0)) // bid_c if bid_c else 0' silently returns 0 when bid_cents is 0; combined with the '<20' threshold this can mislead a paused merchant into thinking their budget is empty. Consider setting low_budget only when status is 'active'. (Already gated by status==active — OK.)

routes/marketplace_promotions.py:352-362 — _last_sweep throttle is a module-level dict; multi-worker uvicorn will run sweep_renewals up to N times per 45s. For the receipt-email flow that means potentially N receipts per renewal cycle. Consider a Mongo advisory lock (findOneAndUpdate on a sentinel doc).

routes/marketplace_promotions.py:407-431 — _email_renewal_receipt swallows all exceptions silently; if Mailgun rejects (bounce, domain issue) the merchant won't know their renewal receipt was never sent. Consider logging failures + surfacing a UI badge (last_receipt_status).

services/category_bids.py:59 — the spend_date rollover ($set spent_today=0) runs as a separate update BEFORE the atomic billing update; between them another concurrent request could bill against the OLD spent_today. Rare in practice but combining both into a single aggregation pipeline update would be safer.
